ingredients.buy: 3 1/2 lb boneless skinless (7 large breasts, halved lengthwise into 14 cutlets)
ingredients.notes: MAIN-PROTEIN EACH-WEIGHT, WORKED NOT ASSUMED (florentine rule): '2 large breasts' carries no printed weight, so the weight is derived from the source's own 26 g protein/serving - chicken must supply ~24.4 g/serving, giving ~437 g total, i.e. 2 breasts of ~220 g; booked at 225 g/large (house each=200 medium), 450 g source total, recomputing to +6.2% protein vs source.
